trial_court: Family Court, Rangareddy District at L.B.Nagar, F.C.O.P.No.1906 of 2013
case_name: Smt. Sujatha Bai vs G.Hemanth Kumar
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 2009 and have two sons. The husband filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking restitution of conjugal rights. The trial court allowed the petition directing the wife to join her husband for matrimonial life within one month.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking restitution of conjugal rights must establish that the other party has deserted them without a reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: The respondent has not been able to prove that the appellant has deserted him without a reasonable cause.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking restitution of conjugal rights must establish that they have made reasonable efforts to contact the other party.
legal_principles.held: The respondent has not been able to prove that he made reasonable efforts to contact the appellant.

outcome.final_order: The final order directed the wife to join her husband for matrimonial life within one month from the date of order.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court appeals
